title: Security testing: what QA does and where penetration testing begins

videos.script: Somebody books a seat. Then they change one number in the address, and the booking on the screen is somebody else's. {{idor}} No scanner would have caught that. The page loads, the code looks clean, nothing errors. {{clean}} What catches it is a test with two customers in it. The second one asks for the first one's booking, and the answer has to be a refusal. {{two}} That is most of security testing for a tester. You write down what the system must refuse. You turn each sentence into a test. And you keep the scanners running on every change. {{pipeline}} Breaking in is a different job. A penetration test is authorised in writing, has a scope, and is done by specialists. {{pentest}} And trying any of this on a system you do not own is a crime. So everything here happens on your own machine, at one two seven, zero, zero, one. {{local}} In this lesson you type in a small account service for the box office, with its defences in place. {{service}} Then a suite of tests that proves each one holds. And you take one defence out, on purpose, to watch its test go red. {{red}}
